layouts.name: Eagles Canyon Raceway
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full Italian Canyon course follows all fifteen numbered turns in the operator course map, including both western bends, the central inner loop, southern hairpin and long southeastern return. The Italian Canyon 2.7-mile configuration excludes the shorter mapped connector. The independent source length 4285.8 m is preserved, with the catalogue/operator distance discrepancy documented and no coordinate adjustment. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4285.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
